question: Will the daily minimum temperature at Beijing Nanjiao Observatory be below 0°C on Nov 30, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the official daily minimum temperature recorded at Beijing Nanjiao Observatory (南郊观象台) for November 30, 2026 (covering the 24-hour period of that calendar day in China Standard Time, CST, i.e. UTC+8) is strictly below 0°C, as published by the China Meteorological Administration or the Beijing Meteorological Bureau, with the observation report available strictly after 2026-11-29T16:00:00Z and at or before 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if the official daily minimum temperature recorded at Beijing Nanjiao Observatory (南郊观象台) for November 30, 2026 is 0°C or above, as published by the China Meteorological Administration or the Beijing Meteorological Bureau, with the observation report available strictly after 2026-11-29T16:00:00Z and at or before 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z.

Clarifications:
- The "daily minimum temperature" refers to the lowest air temperature (in °C) officially recorded at Beijing Nanjiao Observatory over the full calendar day of November 30, 2026 in China Standard Time (CST, UTC+8), as reported in official surface observation records.
